obligations.description: Result should remain non-negative under validated inputs

assumptions.description: Balance must be non-negative at the time of withdrawal
assumptions.justification: Account balance is initialized to zero or positive at account creation and only modified through validated operations; a negative balance is not a valid state

assumptions.description: Withdrawal amount must be non-negative; a negative withdrawal would be semantically a deposit and is not permitted through this function
assumptions.justification: Withdrawal API schema enforces that the amount field is a non-negative integer before the call reaches this function
